recommended_profile.rationale: Short-subtitle app latency approaches maximum offload while saving 2.658 GB dedicated GPU and approximately 2.7 GB private commit. It is much faster than tested low-CPU sub-8-GB placements. No approved latency SLA is inferred.

alternatives.tradeoff: Lowest GPU/private commit; substantially more CPU expert computation.
Sub-8-GB and low residual CPU; cache misses/transfers cost latency.
Faster sub-8-GB ordinary partial offload, but approximately 1.67 core-equivalents standalone serving CPU.
Near preferred target, low residual CPU; materially slower than above-target n12 placement.
Lowest measured app latency, additional 2.658 GB dedicated GPU versus recommendation.
Current shipped reference, not equal-quality/model evidence; substantially lower host memory.

failure_findings: 4096-MiB cache failed a 2861438976-byte bank/device maximum-buffer-size check before readiness; not total VRAM exhaustion or an 8-GB cutoff.
Initial cache2048 serving succeeded but required forced shutdown; destructor statistics unavailable for that record, not synthesized.

Initial app harness rejected expected keyless-STT degraded language receipt before manual text submission. Director authorized manual translation with exact provider.stt/stt.provider_not_ready boundary retained.

owner_decision.decision: Accept the recommended above-8-GB GPU/private-commit premium for measured latency, or prioritize headroom and choose the documented sub-8-GB frontier.
owner_decision.production_rollout: Not authorized. Retain E4B until separate managed 26B integration/resource acceptance and rollout authorization.

limits: Only the measured RX 7900 XTX 24-GiB-class device; no 8-GB-card, VRChat co-render, GUI presentation or live audio/ASR claim.
Headless unmodified app uses an external user-managed endpoint, not managed 26B provisioning/prefix cache/lifecycle readiness.
App-only restart preserves the external model process; model restart persistence is not established by this probe.
Sampled GPU peaks are lower bounds; absent app GPU counter rows remain unavailable, not zero. Whole-adapter memory separately encloses background allocations.
Early default RAM-cache profiles experienced host-memory pressure; those tails are not clean cache-only causal comparisons.
Physical PCIe bytes, per-request cache counters, per-process hard-paging, power and exact lifetime GPU high-water unavailable.
Small synthetic fidelity set, unresolved name reading, minor temporal precision drift and E4B gender/noun caveats; no broad quality superiority claim.
